brief:
Kaja Kallas, the European Union's foreign policy chief, said the EU should treat illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian Territories similarly to Russian-occupied Crimea, according to Middle East Eye. Kallas's statement suggests applying comparable diplomatic and legal frameworks to both territorial disputes.

The comparison marks a notable escalation in EU rhetoric toward Israeli settlement policy, which the international community widely considers illegal under international law.
